initial_config_timing: recorded after A fits and before aggregated A outcome inspection; B/C rules fixed before their formal runs
controlled_feedback: within each original 120-question outer stream, 20 frozen logging-support questions precede an untouched 100-question query evaluator
noise_variants: N3 shares the exact E3 correlation matrix with N2; N4/N5 share history-only OOF residual second-moment scales; shrinkage .5 fixed
seed_learning_curve: N1 only with authorized seed subsets; both fixed alpha100 and matched alpha100*L/3
C_primary_models: P1/P2 crossed with text-only/task-known, four likelihood models, historical CV alpha grid1/10/100
metadata_scope: P2-only subtask-oracle/subtask-predicted sensitivity, separate from deployment-candidate selection
D_candidate: P2_text-only_probit selected by development OOF Brier, numerical lead5.658e-6, no established superiority
D_additional_control: Gaussian Probability-DA separates Bernoulli-outcome enumeration from Platt recalibration; original Gaussian linear KG retained
D_calibration: history-only question-OOF Platt map changes acquisition weights/utilities, actor service and update remain fixed
D_inference: same gold20 is not equal total token cost; actual cost axes, conditional paired intervals and multiplicity retained
variance_bootstrap: finite-stratum signal variance CI recentered with explicit original-percentile sensitivity; point estimates unchanged
optimization_audit: original MAP/Laplace reference residuals retained; separate Newton-polished numerical reference audit, no silent actor replacement
protected_inputs: raw questions, gold, embeddings, answer text, exact line-level receipts and private arrays retained locally
sealed: fresh400/sealed200 scores not used; boundary checks based on code, manifests and explicit invariance tests, not OS-level forensic access logging
